ok so there was this tree named Gary.. he was a big redwood on the midwestern coast. he grew up with lots of brothers and sisters, and they all talked about the weather and made friends with the animals who used them as homes. one day Gary met a friendly bear named sare. she liked to use his feets as a scratching post for her furry back:P he asked her why she would only use him to scratch herself and she explained that his old chippy bark was the best for getting deep past her thick hide. this made Gary feel special, and so they became good friends. one day a bunch of men with big yellow trucks came and started taking Gary's brothers and sisters away. he watched them fall to the ground and felt kinda sad.. sare the bear came running and with a worried look she said she didn't want them to take Gary. he didn't want them to either. then he realized that the men were coming for him and sare stood up to try and scare them away. it was no use.. their loud cutting machines made her scared too so she climbed up to Garys tallest branch and he wrapped his leaves around her to shield her eye from what was about to happen. the cutting machines began to roar and Gary started to feel the sting from them separating his feets from his body. he wanted to cry with pain but didn't wanna scare sare so he kept it inside until he began to lose his balance. sare felt safe at the top of Gary, but with a loud crack her eyes widened in fear because she knew Gary was gone from his body. his leaves began to loosen from around her and she felt him start to tip. BOOM! he finally hit the ground but his branches softened the fall for sare. she stayed beside him for as long as she could but the men with loud machines started to close in around her. she asked them why they took her friend. why they were taking his family.. but they didn't seem to hear her. maybe they just couldn't understand. in a fit of rage sare stood up and yelled at them from the top of her lungs "whyy!" the men stood back. they weren't fucking with no bear. one of the men approached with a big gun. he shot it in the air and every living thing dispersed. birds flew away, squirrels scampered off into hollow logs on the forest bed.. but sare just stood there. "whyyy!" she cried out again.. the man shot his gun for a second time and it was then that hope completely faded and sare realized she needed to hide. she ran off into the forest and looked on from behind a raspberry bush. the horrible things they did to Gary would haunt her for the rest of her days. every tree she scratched herself on never felt the same after that. every salmon she caught, she would bring to the field where Gary once stood. she missed Gary. but one day as she was rummaging through a dumpster, she came across a book. it had pictures of big trees like Gary and then other pictures of fancy benches and decks. she flipped through with her claws and came across a house. a little log cabin made of redwood. "Gary!" she exclaimed.. he was in pieces, but she could tell he was content. he looked as beautiful as ever. somehow she could read so she saw that what was left of Gary was in a forest ~800 km north from where he once stood, so with that she took her leave to find the cabin in hopes of scratching her back once more..
